# Trycord Brand Guidelines (v1.0)

## Brand voice
Clear, capable, welcoming, open. Avoid needless jargon and loud visual effects.

## Logo
Use `brand/trycord-lockup-dark.svg` on dark surfaces and `brand/trycord-lockup-light.svg` on light surfaces. Use `brand/trycord-symbol.svg` where space is constrained. Keep clear space at least the width of the inner symbol cutout. Do not stretch, skew, recolor arbitrarily, or add glow/shadows.

## Color
Flame `#FF4D24` is the signature accent. Charcoal is the structural foundation. Maintain contrast and avoid orange body text on dark surfaces for long passages.

## Typography
Use Manrope for product and brand typography. Use a monospace family for code and technical identifiers. Use font weights 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800 selectively.

## Icons
Use 24px viewboxes, consistent 2px rounded strokes, and inherit color wherever possible. Keep icon-only controls accessible with labels or accessible names.

## Shape language
Structural containers are compact and squared; controls and dialogs use restrained rounding. Suggested radii: 4, 8, 12, and 16px.

## Motion
Use short transitions, no unnecessary bounce. Respect reduced-motion settings.

## Accessibility
Check contrast in both themes, visible keyboard focus, semantic labels, and non-color cues for state. Check small-size legibility for app icon and favicon.

## Asset maintenance
Keep vector source files in version control. Use semantic filenames and add new icons in the same grid/stroke system. Document external fonts or other third-party assets separately.
